title: Race Conditions Advanced
description: Timing windows across concurrent requests and state transitions.

attacks.name: Single-packet attack
attacks.desc: Packing requests into one packet can align their arrival and expose race windows in state updates.
attacks.prevention: Make state changes atomic and idempotent, so synchronized requests cannot both pass a single-use check.

attacks.name: Last-byte sync
attacks.desc: Holding the final byte of requests can synchronize completion and reveal timing-dependent behavior.
attacks.prevention: Avoid separate read-then-write checks; use database constraints or transactions to guard shared state.

attacks.name: Limit-overrun
attacks.desc: Concurrent operations may exceed a one-time limit before a shared counter is updated.

attacks.name: Multi-endpoint race
attacks.desc: Actions sent to different endpoints can race against the same underlying account or object state.

attacks.name: Partial construction race
attacks.desc: Another request may observe a partially created object before initialization or permissions finish.

attacks.name: Time-of-check-to-use
attacks.desc: A value can change between validation and use if the operation is not atomic.

attacks.name: Session race
attacks.desc: Parallel login or session updates can leave inconsistent authentication state.
